allegro_cookie.description:
**⚠️ Experimental.** Allegro has no public API for buyers, so the integration uses your browser session (the `QXLSESSID` cookie). It may stop working when Allegro changes its website.

**How to get the cookie:**
1. Sign in at [allegro.pl]({allegro_url}) in a desktop browser.
2. Press **F12** to open the developer tools.
3. Firefox: **Storage** tab → **Cookies** → `{allegro_url}`. Chrome / Edge: **Application** tab → **Cookies** → `{allegro_url}`.
4. Find the **QXLSESSID** row and copy the value from the **Value** column.
5. Paste it below.

The cookie gives access to your Allegro account, never share it. Signing out of Allegro in that browser may invalidate the session. When the session expires, paste a new cookie in the account options (**Configure**).

inpost_login.description:
InPost accounts are signed in on the InPost website. It has a captcha, so you sign in in your own browser and give Home Assistant the address the sign-in ends on.

1. [Open the InPost sign-in page]({login_url}) and sign in with your phone number or e-mail.
2. When the sign-in finishes, the browser shows an InPost page whose address starts with `account.inpost-group.com/callback?code=`. Copy the **whole address from the address bar**.
3. Paste it below right away: the code in it expires after a few minutes.

Signing in with e-mail: open the link from the e-mail in the same browser. The sign-in then finishes in the tab where you started, copy the address from that tab.

More than one InPost account: the InPost page remembers the signed-in account and has no simple way to sign out. Copy the link and open it in a private (incognito) window for each account.

inpost_reauth.description:
InPost no longer accepts the saved session for {phone}, so its parcels are not updated. Select **Submit** to sign in again.

InPost has changed how accounts sign in: accounts added with the earlier SMS-code login have to sign in once with the new method.

reauth_confirm.description: Your Allegro session has expired. Sign in at [allegro.pl]({allegro_url}), copy the new **QXLSESSID** cookie the same way as when adding the account (F12 → Storage / Application → Cookies → `{allegro_url}`) and paste it below.

error.auth_error: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.
error.inpost_no_code: There is no sign-in code in the pasted text. After signing in, paste the whole address from the browser's address bar (…/callback?code=…).
error.inpost_sms_code: This looks like an SMS code. Enter it on the InPost page, then paste the address the browser shows after signing in.
error.inpost_wrong_attempt: This address comes from an earlier sign-in attempt. Sign in with the link above and paste the new address.
error.inpost_code_expired: InPost rejected the code: it has expired or was already used. Sign in again with the new link above and paste the address right away.
error.inpost_wrong_account: You signed in to a different InPost account than the one being renewed. Sign in again with the new link above, using that account's phone number or e-mail.

abort.reauth_successful: The account sign-in has been updated.

init.description: Recipient filters, one pattern per line (or comma separated). A pattern matches the recipient phone number (last 9 digits), name or address, including the pickup point address; letter case and Polish characters are ignored. Include: only parcels matching any pattern are shown. Exclude: parcels matching any pattern are hidden. Parcels with no recipient data are always shown. Hidden shipments: tracking numbers you hid by hand (also with the Hide shipment button); remove a number to show the parcel again.
